summary: Study ISO 18788 SOMS concepts, requirements, and processes in PECB Foundation training. Prepare for the exam and earn 14 CPD credits.
audienceIntro: ISO 18788 Foundation is designed for people involved in security operations and those building knowledge of SOMS processes. It suits professionals who need a foundation-level view of how ISO 18788 connects policy, requirements, risk assessment, and management-system review.
prerequisites: There are no prerequisites to participate in this training course. To apply for the PECB Certificate Holder in ISO 18788 Foundation credential, you must pass the PECB ISO 18788 Foundation exam and sign the PECB Code of Ethics. The PECB course page lists no professional experience, management-system audit or assessment experience, or SOMS project experience requirement.
